mcl-core.subject: Harden registry validator against overflow and file truncation

mcl-wire.subject: Eliminate compiler-synthesized memset in freestanding wire object

mcl-link.subject: Fix wire major mask narrowing and enforce context lifecycle invariants

mcl-sdk.subject: Fix consumer dependency graph so Wire and Link are public to SDK library

mcl-ap.subject: Implement Experiment 001 known-waveform acoustic modem testbed

layer_status.mcl-core: Provisional Tier-0 semantic registry (6 categories, 6 opcodes). C validator with overflow/truncation hardening.
layer_status.mcl-wire: Freestanding C99 reference codec. Bit-level encode/decode for 6 Tier-0 semantics. Extension framework present. Randomized fuzz decode. Known test vectors. Zero heap allocation.
layer_status.mcl-link: C99 reference state machine. 9-state lifecycle. Context install/authorize/compare. Wire major mask without narrowing. Coexistence tested with Wire.
layer_status.mcl-sdk: C99 reference SDK. Node init/reset, Tier-0 send/receive, Link lifecycle wrappers. Zero side-effect decode. Transport callback delivers raw Wire bytes only.
layer_status.mcl-ap: Analytical channel model (ISO 9613-1) + Experiment 001 (LAB/EXPERIMENTAL binary FSK modem testbed). No normative profile. AP-B0 NOT selected.
layer_status.mcl-ip: Draft binding specification only. No implementation.
layer_status.mcl-ble: Draft binding specification only. No implementation.
layer_status.mcl-uwb: Draft binding specification only. No implementation.

C0_static_registry.detail: semantic-codes-v0.2.json validated by tools/validate_registry.c with overflow and truncation hardening.

C1_canonical_encoding.detail: 6 Tier-0 semantics encode/decode bit-perfectly. Known test vectors retained in mcl-wire/tests/test_vectors.c.

C2_negative_decoding.detail: Truncated, malformed-opcode, noncanonical-padding, and oversized inputs tested. Randomized fuzz_decode exercised.

C3_link_state_tests.detail: 9-state lifecycle transitions, context install/reject in forbidden states, wire major mask boundary (0..UINT32_MAX), context compare.

C4_independent_interoperability.detail: No independent implementation exists to test against.

C5_ap_physical_profile_conformance.detail: No normative AP profile defined. Analytical model and experimental lab testbed only.

C6_device_ecosystem_robustness.detail: No multi-device, multi-transport, or ecosystem-scale testing performed.

E0_analytical.detail: ISO 9613-1 attenuation, spherical spreading, Doppler, serialization time, bitrate-equal-to-propagation. Boundary conditions tested (distance=0, negative, payload=0).

E1_deterministic_simulation.detail: Experiment 001: Binary FSK 300 baud, 48 kHz mono PCM, 4 preamble candidates (LFM chirp, Zadoff-Chu, PN/m-sequence, frequency-diverse). Evaluated under AWGN sweep (40-10 dB), clipping (0.9-0.3), SRO (10-500 ppm). Clean channel Wire->FSK->Wire bit-perfect across all 6 Tier-0 kinds.

E2_replay.detail: No recorded acoustic field captures replayed.

E3_controlled_over_air_frame.detail: Exact source WAV generated (exp001_e3_source.wav, SHA256: 7B4D7B038F4C6ABB496BAFBFFA4E307AAE70DFAAD1176E02BB0356225ECBBF69). Offline WAV decoder implemented (decode_wav.c). Physical speaker->air->mic playback/record awaiting physical human acoustic session.

msvc_19_51.detail: Wire, Link, SDK compile and pass all tests under MSVC 19.51 /W4 /WX /std:c11.

clang_17_host.detail: Wire, Link, SDK compile with -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion -Wsign-conversion -Wshadow -Wundef -Werror. All 8 host test suites pass 100%.

arm_cortex_m0.detail: Compiled wire.c, extension.c, link.c, sdk.c with --target=arm-none-eabi -mcpu=cortex-m0 -mthumb -std=c99 -Os -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -Werror. llvm-nm verified zero unexpected undefined symbols (no malloc/memcpy/stdio/OS). SDK retains only 7 lower-layer MCL symbols.

riscv32_rv32im.detail: Compiled wire.c, extension.c, link.c, sdk.c with --target=riscv32-none-elf -march=rv32im -mabi=ilp32 -std=c99 -Os -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -Werror. llvm-nm verified zero unexpected undefined symbols. SDK retains only 7 lower-layer MCL symbols.
